tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Use first to see what this server covers and which tools are free. Inputs: none. Output: JSON with each tool, its cost, data coverage (visa-free routes for mainland China; official regulation releases), dataset dates and auth method. Cost: free, no key, 50 free-tool calls per IP per day in total.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Use when the user asks about cost, hits the free limit, or needs more calls. Inputs: none. Output: JSON with the free-tool limit, prepaid credit packs and their Stripe Payment Links, the USDC-on-Base endpoint and steps, and the cost of each tool. Cost: free, no key, 50 free-tool calls per IP per day

tools.name: sample_eligibility
tools.description: Use to preview the shape and quality of eligibility data. Inputs: optional "nationality" (English country name; default "Germany"). Output: a short sample: whether ordinary passports are visa-free, max days, route names and one source link. For full routes, conditions, dates and all sources use chec

tools.name: check_visa_free_eligibility
tools.description: Use when someone asks whether a passport holder can enter mainland China without a visa, and for how long. Inputs: "nationality" (English country name, e.g. "Germany"). Output: JSON with visa_free_for_ordinary_passports, max_days, and every applicable route (30-day unilateral exemption, mutual agree

tools.name: latest_regulation_changes
tools.description: Use to brief a foreign business on recent official Chinese regulations and policy releases (State Council English releases, MOFCOM). Inputs: optional "limit" (1-20, default 5), "topic" (tag/keyword, e.g. "trade", "export control"), "since" (YYYY-MM-DD). Output: JSON list of items with date, source,

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "sample_eligibility" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
